name: EEVL Media Production Workflow
description: End-to-end media production pipeline for Eagle Eye Vision Labz. Covers the 3-pillar model: Video + Drone + Photo — from client brief intake through final delivery and invoicing. Upgraded with 3-tier agent escalation routing.

tasks.name: Pre-Production
tasks.description: Client brief analysis, shot list generation, equipment planning, scheduling, and project channel creation.

tasks.name: Shoot Day
tasks.description: On-location shoot execution, real-time status updates, file capture and naming, drone flight logging.
tasks.note: Shoot day is almost entirely physical + Tier 1 automation. Agents provide real-time support via Lark and ClickUp.

tasks.name: Post-Production
tasks.description: Raw file organization, Sparrow handoff for editing, revision tracking, and final export. Includes Cowork for heavy file analysis and Computer Use fallback for creator app deep UI.

tasks.name: Client Delivery
tasks.description: Final deliverable packaging, invoicing, client notification, and project archival. Dispatch-enabled for mobile delivery approval.

triggers.description: Triggered when a new task is created in the EEVL Production ClickUp space with the 'new-project' tag.
Triggered when a message is posted to the #new-projects Lark channel with the @eevl-bot mention.
Triggered via 'Hey Siri, new EEVL project' — captures client name, project type, and date, routes to orchestrator.
Mobile trigger via Claude Dispatch — submit project brief from phone for async processing.
Manually triggered by a team member through the EEVL dashboard or CLI.

mcp_connections.description: File storage for briefs, raw footage, edited deliverables, and client-shared folders.
Team communication, project channels, shoot-day status updates, and Sparrow handoff via #edited-by-sparrow.
Invoice generation and payment tracking for completed projects.
Client communication — delivery emails with download links and invoice attachments.
Tier 2 — persistent workspace for heavy file analysis, transcription, edit brief synthesis, and color science research.
Tier 3 — GUI automation fallback for creator apps (Final Cut, Logic) when AppleScript/CLI paths are exhausted.
mcp_connections.guardrails: 10 min max, single app scope, user approval required

sub_agents.name: Sparrow Handoff Agent
sub_agents.description: Packages raw files from a completed shoot, organizes them by pillar (Video/Drone/Photo), and posts a structured handoff message to the #edited-by-sparrow Lark channel for Sparrow to pick up and edit.

sub_agents.name: EEVL Creative Agent
sub_agents.description: Brand-kit design generation for thumbnails, social assets, and presentation materials. Triggered during client delivery for delivery manifest design.

shortcuts.name: New EEVL Project
shortcuts.action: Capture client name + project type → POST to orchestrator → start pre-production

shortcuts.name: Check Project Status
shortcuts.action: Query ClickUp for project status → read back via Siri or write to OmniFocus

shortcuts.name: Approve Delivery
shortcuts.action: Finalize Stripe invoice + trigger Gmail delivery email from phone

applescript.use_case: Export timeline XML, import cut lists, batch rename clips
Write project timeline from ClickUp milestones, export Gantt PDF for client

launchd.name: com.eevl.shoot-reminder
launchd.action: Push notification with weather, equipment status, and drive time to location
